extras: Pro features require a GitHub sponsorship. The plugin sends no telemetry or vault data during operation.
intentEvidence: Read two existing language versions in matched paragraph rows.
problem: Comparing two versions of a passage is difficult when the prose blocks do not align perfectly or when one version is significantly longer than the other.
summary: A reader that displays two selected Markdown notes side-by-side, aligning prose blocks into matched rows for direct comparison.
